_description: Identifier-rewrite spec for /usr/lib/unifi-video/lib/airvision.jar.
Applied at container start by /opt/uv-patcher/uv-patcher.jar.
AUTO-DISCOVERY (Phase 3 / v3.10.13-13).  The patcher walks airvision.jar with
ASM and identifies every JLS/JVM-Spec-4.2.2-illegal identifier (class names,
package segments, method names, field names) -- then rewrites each one with a
deterministic, idempotent escape rule (see ReservedNames.java).
BOOTSTRAP CALL-SITE REWRITE (Phase 3.5 / v3.10.13-15).  The same pass also
rewrites airvision's two dangling Tomcat 9 instance-method call sites
(com/ubnt/common/oOOO/A.<init>'s setCatalinaBase/setCatalinaHome calls) to
the equivalent System.setProperty calls.  See BootstrapCallSiteRewriter.java.
Retires the separate tomcat-bootstrap-shim pass that v3.10.13-13 used to
inject the missing instance methods into tomcat-embed-core-9.0.118.jar.
Net effect: tomcat-embed-core ships AND stays bit-pristine in the running
container.
Why this spec is now tiny: the previous Phase 3 design hand-maintained a list
of exactly the 6 obfuscated classes under com/ubnt/A/super/oOOO/.  The first
smoke build revealed that Ubiquiti's obfuscator emits another ~130+ spec-
illegal class paths scattered throughout com/ubnt/airvision/.  Auto-discovery
handles all of them by construction and survives future obfuscation pattern
changes without code or spec edits.
What still lives in this file:
- jarFilenameRenames: Manifest Class-Path token replacements (the lib/
filename normalisation that the auto-discovery pass cannot infer from
bytecode alone -- the .jar filenames are filesystem-level and need to
line up with what the Dockerfile actually installs).
- jarFilenameAdditions: extra Class-Path entries (Java 11+ JAXB / JAF).
- manifestActions: which manifest surgery steps to run.
Escape rules (applied automatically by the patcher; see ReservedNames):
- Class simple name reserved word / java.lang name -> Z<Capitalised>
(super -> ZSuper, Object -> ZObject, String -> ZString).
- Package segment reserved word -> Z<lowercase>
(super -> Zsuper, class -> Zclass, return -> Zreturn).
- Method / field name reserved word -> z<name>
(new -> znew, void -> zvoid, return -> zreturn, int -> zint).
- Method / field name containing '.' -> '.' replaced with '_'
(new.super -> new_super).
- <init> and <clinit> are preserved verbatim.
Cross-references: the original obfuscated bundle (com/ubnt/A/super/oOOO/) is
the UBNT discovery/Inform protocol handler bound to UDP 233.89.188.1:10001
(NOT licensing/DRM, contrary to v3.10.13-4 speculation).  Confirmed by CFR
decompile at /root/uv-harden/decompile/airvision-src/com/ubnt/A/super/oOOO/.
Idempotency: the patcher reads MANIFEST.MF's Patched-By attribute.  If
present and starting with 'uv-patcher', the rewrite is skipped.

_comment: Token in airvision.jar's Manifest Class-Path attribute -> replacement.
An empty-string replacement removes the token entirely (used for the
two vestigial tomcat-embed-logging-* JARs that Phase 3 retires).
The lib/ filesystem rename happens in the Dockerfile in lockstep with
this list; if you change one, change the other.  See checksums/SHA256SUMS

_jarFilenameAdditions_comment: Phase 3.2: JAXB + JAF runtime libs (removed from JDK in Java 11).
and javax.activation.DataSource; without these JARs on airvision.jar's
Manifest Class-Path the Guice filter throws TypeNotPresentException
at Tomcat startup, every web route 404s, the EMS email service
fails its initialiser, and the broken state is masked because the
file appender swallows the stack trace.  Filenames must match the
shared utility classes into a separate Maven artifact starting in 1.71;
bcpkix-jdk18on's pom hard-depends on it.  Without bcutil on the
Class-Path, airvision's self-signed cert generation + PKCS#10 CSR flows
would throw NoClassDefFoundError at first use.  The legacy 1.60 jars
didn't need this -- the utility classes lived inside bcprov-jdk15on-160.jar.
_changelog: v4 (Phase 5 / v3.10.13-19) -- BOUNCYCASTLE 1.60 -> 1.84.  Adds four
Manifest Class-Path token rewrites for the jdk15on -> jdk18on artifact
rename (bcprov, bcpkix) and the two BC artifact retirements (bcprov-ext
discontinued by upstream at 1.78.1; bctls unused -- airvision registers
BouncyCastleProvider only, never BouncyCastleJsseProvider, and JDK 21
JSSE handles the :7443/:7442 connectors).  Adds bcutil-jdk18on-1.84.jar
to jarFilenameAdditions: BC's shared utility classes moved into a
separate Maven artifact in 1.71+ and bcpkix's pom hard-depends on it.
No patcher code changes -- this is pure spec configuration; the existing
rename-with-empty-replacement removal mechanism (used since Phase 3 for
tomcat-embed-logging-{juli,log4j}.jar) handles the bcprov-ext and bctls
removals cleanly.
v3 (Phase 3.5 / v3.10.13-15) -- DUAL-MODE COLLAPSE.  The 'mode' tag is
removed; the airvision pass now also rewrites the two dangling Tomcat
9 Bootstrap.setCatalina{Base,Home} call sites in airvision's own
bytecode (see BootstrapCallSiteRewriter.java).  The separate
tomcat-bootstrap-shim.json + TomcatBootstrapShim.java that v2 carried
are deleted; tomcat-embed-core-9.0.118.jar is no longer modified at
runtime.
v2 (Phase 3 / v3.10.13-13 retry) -- AUTO-DISCOVERY.  Static class/method/
field rename maps removed; the patcher now scans the JAR and applies
deterministic escape rules to every spec-illegal identifier (~130+
paths in practice, not the 6 the v1 spec assumed).  This file shrinks
to filesystem-level filename renames + manifest action flags only.
v1 (Phase 3 / v3.10.13-13 initial) -- 6 hand-curated class renames under
com/ubnt/A/super/oOOO/.  Caught by the pre-push smoke build as
incomplete; replaced by auto-discovery in v2.
